topography.project_purpose: Launchpad. Structurally: 48 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 1 ERC20 token, 3 ERC721 NFTs; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 7 common project-authored base contract(s) (jbpermissioned, jbdeadline, jbsuckerdeployer). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
